benchmark_check.note: Fit-quality check: the model is calibrated on these same points. Not independent validation. Import external GCMC/ML results to validate properly.

sensitivity.note: Across 4.0-8.0 kJ/mol the Run 6 answer at 10 bar moves by 19x. The spec's sanity gate is 3x.

convergence.method: bootstrap refit of the 77 K benchmark within its +/-15% tolerance
convergence.note: This model is closed-form and has no Monte Carlo cycles to converge. The figures below report FIT STABILITY, not GCMC convergence. If the specification's first-choice GCMC route is used instead, replace this with the production cycle count and a real uptake-vs-cycles trace.

uncertainty.note: Fit uncertainty is small; q_st uncertainty dominates by more than an order of magnitude. Quoting a single standard deviation without the q_st span would understate the real uncertainty severely.
